measurement_notes.frame_times: Measured CPU wall-frame intervals, not GPU execution duration.
measurement_notes.input: Benchmark smoke mode disables OS cursor capture and reports os_capture_exercised=false. Reference acceptance uses the native OS-pointer helper for actual picking/keys; this does not turn CPU wall timings into a cursor-capture benchmark.
measurement_notes.readiness: Baseline, slots-only and final default Player use legacy open/layout readiness. Extended Player/Chest cases require two frames with actually painted panels and slots. Request-to-visible latency is reported without a before/after percentage; maximum observed transition frames are compared conservatively.
measurement_notes.resources: RSS and DRM peaks include process startup, assets and all phases. DRM VRAM/GTT are residency, not GPU time. Short repeated cycles do not establish long-run memory bounds.
measurement_notes.scopes: Nested/concurrent scopes must not be added or subtracted to derive exclusive time. Transition windows contain closed spans only; cumulative maxima in phase scopes include prior phases/startup.
measurement_notes.style_interval: ui.style is the scheduler interval bracketing the public TiltUiStyleRuntimeSet::Apply set. It includes scheduling/interleaved work and can overlap ui.reactivity; it is an upper bound around style application, not exclusive private-function CPU time.
